sql:
SELECT C.cl_srl, C.cl_type, C.cl_cate, C.mb_id, C.cl_name, C.cl_title, C.cl_host, C.cl_start_date, C.cl_end_date, C.cl_target,
                C.cl_status, C.cl_dday, C.cl_reg_date, A.ad_srl, C.cl_update,
								(SELECT SUM(cv_visit) FROM a2_contest_visit WHERE cl_srl = C.cl_srl) AS cl_view
            FROM a2_ad_list A LEFT JOIN a2_contest_list C
                ON A.cl_srl = C.cl_srl
            WHERE C.cl_status > 0 AND C.cl_disp = 1 AND C.cl_type IN (1,3) AND C.cl_reserve_date < '2026-11-12 09:08:42' /*AND A.ad_status = 2*/ AND A.ad_code = 'BOT'
            AND A.ad_st < '2026-11-12 09:08:42' AND A.ad_et > '2026-11-12 09:08:42'  AND (FIND_IN_SET(1, REPLACE(C.cl_target, ' ', '')) > 0 OR FIND_IN_SET(2, REPLACE(C.cl_target, ' ', '')) > 0 OR FIND_IN_SET(3, REPLACE(C.cl_target, ' ', '')) > 0 OR FIND_IN_SET(4, REPLACE(C.cl_target, ' ', '')) > 0 OR FIND_IN_SET(8, REPLACE(C.cl_target, ' ', '')) > 0 OR FIND_IN_SET(9, REPLACE(C.cl_target, ' ', '')) > 0)  order by A.ad_order asc, A.ad_et desc

rows.cl_cate: 아이디어·창업·마케팅·네이밍대학생대학원생
